recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed for FHIR-39031 unless a future work-group decision introduces client-requestable notification shaping.
issue_request: FHIR-39031 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification R5 ballot issue asking whether SubscriptionTopic.notificationShape.include and revInclude indicate server-supported options, and whether clients should be able to request include/revInclude choices on Subscription. The work group decided related resources are at server discretion, not client-requested, and that the existing client-expectation sentence should be surfaced in the main documentation.
initial_application: Element definitions for SubscriptionTopic.trigger.notificationShape.include and revInclude already contained the client expectation that clients SHOULD be prepared to receive additional resources but SHALL function properly without them. Commit 18d9f5a194038b2b3154e1dcc24ae9abacdb61c8 explicitly applied FHIR-39031 on 2023-02-15 by adding that sentence to source/subscriptiontopic/subscriptiontopic-notes.xml and changing included-resource style guidance to SHOULD.
additional_context: SubscriptionTopic is active in source/fhir.ini, so source/subscriptiontopic/structuredefinition-SubscriptionTopic.xml and source/subscriptiontopic/subscriptiontopic-notes.xml feed the current build. Current SubscriptionTopic narrative retains the include/revInclude guidance, client behavior without additional resources, optional shape support, and no discovery mechanism. Current Subscription only exposes filterBy for client-requested filtering and has no include/revInclude request fields, matching the Jira disposition. FHIR-I WGM 202301 minutes confirm the action to bring element-definition text into main documentation; no relevant Zulip or conflicting Confluence evidence was found.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source already satisfies the approved clarification without adding redundant prose or new Subscription elements.

related_jiras.note: Earlier SubscriptionTopic work added revInclude and the include/revInclude element-definition client-expectation language that FHIR-39031 later asked to surface in narrative.
